title: Purchase Orders

launcher.title: Purchase Orders
launcher.description: Supplier orders: buy from suppliers and receive goods into stock

subtitle: Supplier orders: order from suppliers, then receive deliveries into stock
emptyFilteredTitle: No purchase orders match your filters
emptyFilteredDescription: Try clearing the search or status filter.
noOrdersDescription: Create your first purchase order to get started.
sendToVendorNoPartner: This order has no supplier — add one to send it
sendEmailDescription: Send the purchase order PDF to {{email}}?
sendEmailNoEmail: This supplier has no email address. Add one in partner settings.
receiptsNote: Receipts generated from this purchase order
linesProgressHint: Received counts completed receipts only; quantities on open receipts are shown as in transit.
allLinesNeedProduct: All lines must have a product name
confirmOrderDescription: Receiving opens once the order is confirmed. You can still cancel it afterwards.
confirmOrderDescriptionThreshold: This organization sends orders above {{threshold}} to the approval queue; the rest can be received once confirmed. You can still cancel it afterwards.
cancelOrderDescription: This will cancel the purchase order. This action cannot be undone.

form.subtitleCreate: Create a new purchase order for supplier
form.partnerRequiredHint: A supplier is needed to confirm this order — you can add it later.
form.noResultsAdHoc: Not in your list — the line will be kept as typed in.
form.adHocBadgeTooltip: Typed in by hand — not a product from your list.
form.scheduledDatePast: Planned date cannot be in the past.

templates.title: Purchase order templates
templates.subtitle: Manage PDF templates for purchase orders
templates.empty: No custom templates yet. The built-in template will be used for purchase order PDFs.
templates.htmlInvalid: The HTML looks unbalanced — check for unclosed tags.

rejectReasonRequired: A reason is required to reject the order.
approveOrderDescription: The purchase order will be confirmed and ready for receiving.
rejectOrderDescription: The purchase order will return to draft so it can be edited and resubmitted.
requestApprovalDescription: Order {{number}} will be parked as pending approval until an approver decides.

settings.title: Approval settings
settings.description: Decide when purchase orders must be approved before they can be confirmed.
settings.requireAll: Require approval for all purchase orders
settings.thresholdHint: Purchase orders above this net total require approval. Leave empty for no threshold.
settings.loadFailed: Could not load the approval settings.

workflowMissing.title: Approval is required, but nothing enforces it
workflowMissing.description: No approval workflow exists for purchase orders, so confirming one is refused. Create the workflow, or turn the requirement off.
workflowMissing.moduleDescription: The Approvals module is off, so there is nowhere for a purchase order to wait. Enable it, or turn the requirement off.
workflowMissing.descriptionThreshold: No approval workflow exists for purchase orders, so confirming one above the threshold is refused. Create the workflow, or clear the approval threshold.
workflowMissing.moduleDescriptionThreshold: The Approvals module is off, so there is nowhere for a purchase order above the threshold to wait. Enable it, or clear the approval threshold.

pricelist.pageSubtitle: Per-supplier price lists and price comparison
pricelist.emptyDescription: Add prices for a supplier to compare offers and enable price-aware procurement.
pricelist.comparisonSubtitle: Find a product to see what each supplier charges for it.
pricelist.comparisonEmpty: No supplier has a price for this product yet.
pricelist.comparisonCatalogOnly: Price comparison works only for products from the catalog.
pricelist.noSupplierDescription: Choose a supplier above to see and edit its price list.
pricelist.minQuantityPositive: Min qty must be greater than 0
pricelist.validToInvalid: Valid to must be on or after valid from
pricelist.duplicateShadowed: not used — a duplicate of this offer is cheaper
pricelist.duplicateRefused: This supplier already has a price for this product over the same dates and minimum quantity. Edit that entry instead.

reorderRules.pageSubtitle: Per-location restock thresholds and low-stock alerts
reorderRules.minDescription: Reorder when available stock drops below this amount.
reorderRules.safetyDescription: Safety stock kept in reserve; stock never falls below this.
reorderRules.emptyDescription: A reorder rule needs a product. Add products in Inventory first, then add a rule here to warn when stock runs low.
reorderRules.emptyFilteredDescription: Clear the search or pick another location.
reorderRules.draftPosSkipped_one: {{count}} alert skipped (covered by reserve, no supplier, or no shortage)
reorderRules.draftPosSkipped_other: {{count}} alerts skipped (covered by reserve, no supplier, or no shortage)
reorderRules.minPositive: Min must be greater than 0 — it is the threshold that makes the rule fire
reorderRules.overCapacity: Rule saved. Note: it wants {{max}} per replenishment — more than the shelf holds ({{capacity}}).

productPicker.emptyCatalogHint: If you don't have any products yet, add them in Inventory first.

permissions.readDesc: Can browse purchase orders, pricelists and reorder rules
permissions.writeDesc: Can create, confirm and receive orders, and e-mail them to suppliers

overdueHint: Scheduled for {{date}} and not fully received yet
confirmOrderDescriptionApproval: Confirming sends this order to the approval queue; receiving opens once it is approved. You can still cancel it afterwards.
confirmOrderUnpriced: Some lines have no price yet, so the total is not known and the order goes to approval. At {{threshold}} or less it needs none: add the prices first.
confirmOrderDeadEndWaits: Confirming sends this order to the stage “{{stage}}”, where it waits until the request is withdrawn or someone can decide it.
requestApprovalDeadEndWaits: Requesting sends order {{number}} to the stage “{{stage}}”, where it waits until the request is withdrawn or someone can decide it.
